title: Mexican Congress hearing on Peruvian alien mummies

tellings.quote: the next day there's this like Mexico City Congress thing about uh these Peruvian, you know, uh alien mummies or whatever.

plain: In 2023, according to Michels, Mexico's Congress in Mexico City held a session about mummies from Peru that were presented as aliens. Michels mentions it only in passing, without naming a source, as something that happened the day after another UFO event. It shows the subject reaching a national lawmaking body.
